name: momentum_score_composite_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, when five independent momentum signals — 2-minute RSI velocity, MACD histogram acceleration, 1-minute rate-of-change, ADX directional bias, and volume-price direction — simultaneously align in the same direction, it indicates that multiple algorithmic strategy families (momentum-chasers, trend-followers, volume-participation systems) are all positioned in the same direction at the same time. This simultaneous agreement at the 1-3 minute timescale on NIFTY signals that institutional order flow has reached critical mass: the underlying directional program trades still have unfilled volume that will continue to absorb liquidity for the next 30-90 seconds. A composite score > 55 (out of 100 max) with 15-second persistence filters out the cases where only one or two indicators spike, leaving only the highest-conviction directional bars where continuation probability is meaningfully elevated.

indicators.name: rsi_24
indicators.purpose: 2-minute RSI captures short-term price velocity on NIFTY. Original RSI(14) was on 1-min bars = 14-minute lookback. We compress to 24 bars (2 min) because we hold 30-90 seconds — we want to detect the ONSET of momentum, not its established state. A 14-min RSI would be entering momentum trades that are already 12 minutes old; 2-min RSI enters near the beginning.

indicators.name: macd_hist_52
indicators.purpose: Original MACD(12,26,9) on 1-min bars means slow MA covers 26 minutes. We compress proportionally to our hold time: holding 30-90s vs original 15-45 min = ~10x compression. Slow MA becomes 52 bars (4.3 min). This maintains the original fast/slow MA ratio (24/52 ≈ 12/26) but at a timescale relevant to our 30-90 second options hold.

indicators.name: roc_12
indicators.purpose: 1-minute rate of change (12 × 5s). Original ROC(10) at 1-min bars = 10-minute lookback. For 30-90s hold on NIFTY, the relevant comparison window is 1 minute: long enough to filter 5-second tick noise, short enough to be predictive at 30-90s horizon. A 10-min ROC on NIFTY would be capturing moves already too old to drive the next 60 seconds.

indicators.name: adx_24_dir
indicators.purpose: 2-minute ADX directional score. Acts as a CONTEXT FILTER (not trade trigger) — confirms that short-term trend direction has some strength before contributing to composite. 24 bars (2 min) is sufficient to establish micro-trend direction on NIFTY at 5s bars without being too noisy. Not scaled from original 14-min ADX because directional confirmation works at any timescale.

indicators.name: vol_mom_60
indicators.purpose: 5-minute volume momentum relative baseline. Volume baseline must be longer than our trade window to avoid circular reference; 60 bars (5 min) captures the current session activity rate. Sign of bar direction weights volume by price impact. Original used SMA(volume, 20) on 1-min bars = 20-min baseline; we compress proportionally (20 min → 5 min) to stay responsive to intraday volume regime shifts.

indicators.name: composite_score
indicators.formula: rsi_score + macd_score + roc_score + adx_score + vol_score (each normalized to [-20, +20])
indicators.purpose: Aggregated signal in range [-100, +100]. Threshold at ±55 means at least 3 of 5 indicators must be near-max agreement, or all 5 must be in moderate agreement. This is the same multi-consensus philosophy as the original strategy.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: cumulative(TP × volume) / cumulative(volume) from session open
indicators.purpose: Intraday VWAP as trend context. Composite signals above VWAP are more likely to persist (VWAP-benchmarked algos are buyers); below VWAP they resist. Same as original's VWAP alignment condition.

conditions: composite_score has been > (threshold - 10) for last 3 bars (15s persistence)
buy_ce.confirmation: 3-bar persistence filter (15 seconds) prevents single-bar spikes from triggering. Same 3-bar logic as original's 3-consecutive-bar confirmation, adapted to 5s bars.

conditions: composite_score has been < -(threshold - 10) for last 3 bars (15s persistence)

exit.stop_rationale: When 5 momentum indicators align on NIFTY, price should not retrace more than 8 spot points (4 option pts at ATM delta ~0.5) within 30 seconds — a retracement of that magnitude means the directional flow has reversed and the multi-indicator consensus has dissolved. Tight relative to typical NIFTY 1-min moves (3-7 pts) because these are high-conviction entries; if thesis is right, no retracement should be needed.
exit.target_rationale: Multi-indicator confluence on NIFTY precedes 15-20 spot point moves over the next 60-90 seconds as remaining institutional orders fill. 7 option pts ≈ 14 spot pts represents the lower bound of this expected move (1:1.75 R:R). Captures roughly 50-70% of the typical continuation before momentum exhausts.

filters.vix_filter: india_vix < 25 — above 25 momentum reversals become unpredictable on NIFTY; multi-indicator alignment breaks down in panic regimes
filters.time_filter: 09:25-15:20 IST — skip first 10 minutes (indicator warmup and opening noise) and last 10 minutes (low liquidity)
filters.volume_filter: volume momentum built into composite score — high-participation direction bars score higher
filters.trend_filter: close vs VWAP alignment required — filters out counter-trend entries where composite spikes against institutional order flow direction
filters.spread_filter: N/A — limit orders at close price

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — composite scoring is computationally non-trivial but replicable; edge may erode if multiple algos begin trading the same multi-indicator alignment on NIFTY

adaptation_notes: Original strategy traded NIFTY200 stocks at 1-min resolution with 15-45 min holds. Key changes: (1) All indicators compressed 10-12x in bar count to match 30-90s hold vs 15-45 min original; (2) VWAP kept (cumulative, no scaling needed); (3) Volume SMA period compressed from 20-min to 5-min baseline; (4) MACD parameters maintain original fast/slow ratio at compressed timescale; (5) Index-specific: indices are smoother/more liquid than individual stocks so composite threshold reduced from 60 to 55 to account for slightly lower per-bar volatility on the index. The multi-indicator consensus philosophy transfers cleanly to index at any timescale.
weaknesses: All 5 indicators are lagging — composite alignment means the directional move has already started; on NIFTY this typically means 3-5 spot pts of initial move are already captured by entry
Signal rarity: composite > 55 with VWAP filter may produce only 2-5 signals per day on NIFTY
5 indicators with normalization parameters = 5 sources of overfitting risk; composite threshold is tunable
Index volume in spot_df may be sparse at 5s; volume-momentum sub-score may underperform compared to stock volume
